data.narrative:
WB Group is a pre-IPO stage Defense & Security company founded by Piotr Wojciechowski. The valuation universe comprises 26 same-sector peers overall, including 2 public comparables (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers, among them Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method is not applicable to this analysis. Despite identifying a broad Defense & Security peer set of 26 companies, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-valuation-tier comparables yielded zero datapoints in each category—falling short of the minimum three-company threshold required for statistical reliability. A full-sector median approach would introduce unacceptable bias, as it would conflate vastly different company maturity levels, business models, and risk profiles within Defense & Security.

Without sufficient narrow-peer triangulation, this analysis cannot support a specific valuation range. The key uncertainties are structural: WB Group's stage and current valuation metrics are not populated in available data, and the private peer set lacks sufficient stage-aligned overlap to enable robust multiples-based benchmarking. Public comps exist but their applicability depends on whether they meaningfully mirror WB Group's revenue, profitability, or growth trajectory—details not provided. A defensible valuation would require either disclosure of WB Group's financials, identification of additional pre-IPO Defense & Security peers at comparable scale, or recourse to DCF methods with management guidance on cash flow projections.
